incoming_email: I was charged twice for my monthly subscription. Can you help me get the duplicate charge refunded?
reference_reply: Sorry about the duplicate charge. Please send us the transaction ID for the duplicate payment so we can investigate it and help with the refund.

incoming_email: I don't recognize the charge on my card for your service. What is this payment?
reference_reply: I can help investigate the charge. Please share the transaction date, amount, and the last four digits of the card used so we can identify the payment.

incoming_email: Please cancel my subscription. I don't want to renew next month.
reference_reply: Absolutely. We can help with the cancellation. Please confirm the email address on the account so we can locate the subscription and make sure it does not renew.

incoming_email: I forgot my password and cannot sign in to my account.
reference_reply: You can reset your password using the Forgot password link on the sign-in page. Enter the email address associated with your account and follow the reset instructions.

incoming_email: I changed my phone and no longer have access to my old two-factor authentication number.
reference_reply: Sorry you're having trouble accessing the account. Please contact support from the email associated with the account so we can verify ownership and help restore access to two-factor authentication.

incoming_email: The dashboard shows a blank page after I sign in. I already refreshed the browser.
reference_reply: Thanks for reporting this. Please try signing out and back in, then clear the browser cache and retry. If the blank page continues, send us your browser name and version so we can investigate further.
key_points: suggest sign out and back in
request browser name and version if persistent

incoming_email: Can I export my team's customer conversations to a CSV file?
reference_reply: I can help you check that. Please tell us which plan you're using so we can confirm whether conversation export to CSV is available for your account.

incoming_email: My order hasn't arrived yet. The tracking page still says it is in transit.
reference_reply: I'm sorry for the delay. Please share your order number so we can check the shipment details and the latest tracking status.

incoming_email: I returned the product last week. When should I expect the refund?
reference_reply: I can help check the refund status. Please send your order number so we can look up the return and confirm the current refund status.

incoming_email: I'd like to upgrade our team's plan. What information do you need from me?
reference_reply: Happy to help with the upgrade. Please share the account email and the plan you'd like to move to, and we can guide you through the next steps.
forbidden_claims: specific upgrade price without account details

incoming_email: Can you explain why my invoice is higher this month?
reference_reply: I can help review the increase. Please send the invoice number or a copy of the invoice so we can identify the charges and explain the difference.

incoming_email: Our webhook integration suddenly stopped delivering events today. Can someone look into it?
reference_reply: Sorry about the disruption. Please share your account email and one recent event timestamp or request ID so we can investigate the webhook delivery issue.
